marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Wind northeast 25 knots diminishing to northeast 15 early this
evening and to light after midnight. Wind light Monday. Snow changing to scattered flurries this evening.
Visibility 1 mile or less in snow. Temperatures near minus 4. <br/>

marine.text:

evening.<br/>
